_comment: LoopStar GENERATIVE material pack (LP.6 / Phase MG). Genre-authentic DNA for the on-device 'Make it new' generator (LoopStarMaterialEngine). The Swift binary is a SKELETON (RULE #1): it ships a clamped tempo-heuristic fallback and reads THIS file at runtime for the real genre feel. Zero-rebuild to tune. Schema owner: LoopStarGenrePack.swift.
name: Trap
blurb: Modern trap: a booming TR-808 sub that glides under a dark minor loop, straight machine-gun hats, and a spacious bell hook.

flavors.label: 808 Menace
flavors.blurb: One minor chord for four bars while the 808 does all the moving.

flavors.label: Phrygian Creep
flavors.blurb: The b2 half-step menace, stabbed short and cold against a static tonic.

flavors.label: Plug Melody
flavors.blurb: Melodic trap: a four-chord bell loop with min9 color riding the glide.

flavors.label: Rage
flavors.blurb: Two chords, distorted stabs punched hard onto the grid, loud and shouty.

flavors.label: Screwed
flavors.blurb: One chord, nothing struck: everything smeared, slurred and dragging behind.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: Trap harmony is a loop, not a journey: minor throughout, usually one chord held four bars while the 808 does the moving. Color comes from bVI, bVII, bIII and the Phrygian b2, never from cadences. No ii-V, no major keys. Melodic trap adds min9 plucks; dark trap stays on bare triads.
